nodes.name: retrieve.py
nodes.summary: Chroma report index: OpenAI-compatible embeddings, ingest job planning, fingerprint/manifest sync, and retrieve_for_tool for Ouroboros skills.
nodes.languageNotes: Talks to an OpenAI-compatible embeddings HTTP API; Chroma persists locally.

nodes.name: OpenAICompatibleEmbeddingFunction
nodes.summary: Chroma embedding function that batches texts to an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint, with optional E5 prefixes and IPv4 preference.

nodes.name: _request_headers
nodes.summary: Builds Authorization and JSON headers for the embeddings API, omitting Bearer when the key is empty.

nodes.name: _embed_batch
nodes.summary: POSTs one embedding batch and returns vectors in input order, raising RuntimeError on HTTP or shape errors.

nodes.name: ChromaRetriever
nodes.summary: Persistent Chroma collection wrapper: fingerprint/manifest, prefix deletes, chunk indexing, and similarity retrieve mapped to Chunk.

nodes.name: index_chunks
nodes.summary: Upserts Chunk texts and metadata into Chroma under a document-id prefix.

nodes.name: retrieve
nodes.summary: Queries the collection for the question and reconstructs Chunk objects from stored metadata.

nodes.name: _prefer_ipv4
nodes.summary: Rewrites an embeddings base URL hostname to a resolved IPv4 address to avoid IPv6 connection issues.

nodes.name: make_embedding_function
nodes.summary: Reads embedding env vars and returns OpenAICompatibleEmbeddingFunction, failing loudly when no API key is set.

nodes.name: drop_redundant_excerpts
nodes.summary: Drops sample excerpt PDFs when a full report for the same agency is already listed in ingest config.

nodes.name: _chunk_from_meta
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a Chunk dataclass from Chroma document text and metadata fields.

nodes.name: _date_from_name
nodes.summary: Parses a report date from a PDF filename using ISO-like and month-name patterns.

nodes.name: _url_for_agency
nodes.summary: Resolves a canonical agency URL from explicit metadata or ingest-config agency_urls.

nodes.name: iter_ingest_jobs
nodes.summary: Yields ingest jobs for sample and full-report PDFs, resolving paths, agencies, dates, and skipping redundant excerpts.

nodes.name: corpus_fingerprint
nodes.summary: Hashes the corpus manifest (paths, sizes, embedding model) so ensure_index can skip unchanged indexes.

nodes.name: plan_corpus_index
nodes.summary: Compares stored vs current corpus fingerprint/manifest and returns an IndexPlan (skip, sync new PDFs, or full rebuild).

nodes.name: ingest_jobs
nodes.summary: Chunks each job PDF and indexes the resulting Chunks on the retriever, returning total chunk count.

nodes.name: ensure_index
nodes.summary: Plans corpus indexing, optionally resets/deletes prefixes, runs ingest_jobs, and writes the new fingerprint and manifest.

nodes.name: ingest_samples_and_reports
nodes.summary: Always rebuilds the index from current ingest jobs (used when force or empty collection requires a full pass).

nodes.name: _default_retriever
nodes.summary: Builds a default ChromaRetriever from env paths and runs ensure_index for retrieve_for_tool.

nodes.name: retrieve_for_tool
nodes.summary: Ouroboros retrieve skill: searches the report index and formats hits with report_citation markdown.

nodes.name: settings.py
nodes.summary: Environment-driven model slots, API-key gates, LangSmith maybe_traceable wrapper, and Ouroboros URL/process env for Docker vs local.

nodes.name: require_deepseek_key
nodes.summary: Returns the DeepSeek/OpenAI-compatible API key or raises RuntimeError if unset (OpenRouter is not a silent fallback).

nodes.name: require_embedding_api_key
nodes.summary: Requires EMBEDDING_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY for the embeddings HTTP API.

nodes.name: maybe_traceable
nodes.summary: Returns langsmith.traceable when tracing is configured, otherwise a no-op decorator so run_turn stays callable.

nodes.name: normalize_chat_model
nodes.summary: Normalizes chat model ids to OpenAI-compatible prefixes expected by the Ouroboros/DeepSeek stack.

nodes.name: resolve_model_slots
nodes.summary: Builds ModelSlots from env (main/heavy/light/eval/skill_review) with DeepSeek-flash defaults and no vendor fallback list.

nodes.name: resolve_ouroboros_url
nodes.summary: Resolves OUROBOROS_URL for host vs Docker (localhost vs compose service, rewriting loopback inside containers).

nodes.name: ouroboros_process_env
nodes.summary: Environment mapping for the Ouroboros subprocess: API base, model slots, light mode, and thinking-off flags.
